sql: select now() as read_at, name, created_at, metadata->>'http' as http_status, metadata->>'submitted' as submitted, metadata->>'sitemap_urls' as sitemap_urls, metadata->>'first_run' as first_run from public.events where name = 'indexnow_submitted' and created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' order by created_at desc limit 12;

with latest as (select created_at, metadata->'snapshot' as snapshot from public.events where name = 'indexnow_snapshot' order by created_at desc limit 1) select now() as read_at, created_at as snapshot_at, snapshot->>'https://www.usekineo.com/gerador-de-shorts-gratis' as portuguese_lastmod_sent, snapshot->>'https://www.usekineo.com/ai-video-generator/for/urdu' as urdu_lastmod_sent, snapshot->>'https://www.usekineo.com/ai-video-generator/seedance' as seedance_lastmod_sent from latest;
